result: Remaining dominant OpenGL GPU-readback wait spikes are NOT fixed. Release retains verified bf1ab0f renderer; speculative changes withdrawn.

method.scope: Apple M3 macOS15.8.2, two maps two physical sizes; wall timings include GPU/native waits, not GPU timestamps or displayed FPS

rejectedDescriptorReuse.reason: FireRed mixed, Emerald markedly worse in both pairs; no performance clearance despite functional byte/window correctness. Not shipped.

rejectedDirectReadback.reason: Byte-exact in 1230848 comparisons, but no consistent render-tail improvement; larger FireRed bedroom renderP99 11.89->12.90ms. Native GL state path not shipped.

rejectedContextRepair.reason: Update and corrected clearDrawable/setView or unlayer attempts all leave GL_FRAMEBUFFER_UNDEFINED. Initial private harness selector error corrected; failed child exited and no protected process was controlled.

limits: GPU/compositor scheduling and other external load are uncontrolled on one host.
Candidate regressions are retained and proposals withdrawn, not claimed fixed.
Prior verified renderer GPU acceptance is retained; actual packaged macOS preview is tested separately before publication.
